title: Healthy Life module: implementation and browser checks verified
summary: 58 focused tests, TypeScript, lint, web export and browser workflows pass. Native-device QA and full translation remain pending. No deployment.

changes.detail: Optional lighter-day preview, date-specific duration changes, conflict-checked rescheduling and activity check-in undo. Planner weekday preferences and independent preference saving.
Four self-paced exercise education paths with persisted difficulty and learning progress; daily knowledge rotation and nutrition myth/warm-up lessons with primary sources.
Study activity opens Focus with its task; editable persistent distraction notes. Illustrated overview, labeled calendar counts and per-habit weekly insights.
Quiet hours now suppress native schedules and browser delivery/catch-up and are reflected in next-reminder previews. Quiet-hours inputs are user-controlled.

Generated plans cap durations to avoid overlapping blocks even in short waking windows. Study activities prefill the focus task and duration while preserving an unfinished timer. Conflicting moves show a specific error.

Compact horizontally scrollable calendar has accessible date/count labels and initially reveals today. Removed duplicated introductory content and show the English-content notice only for non-English interfaces.
Documented architecture, data handling, sources, runnable checks and product limitations in docs/HEALTHY-LIFE.md. Screenshots are historical captures of synthetic test data.

validation.name: Focused automated suite
validation.detail: 58 passed, 0 failed: healthy-life, wellness, clock, browser-reminder, daily-interaction and Change History tests. Added tests for quiet-hours cancellation/delivery, adaptation, protected time, small waking windows, learning data and persistence. Initial screen test needed mocks for the new components; corrected and reran successfully.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused ESLint
validation.detail: npm.cmd run typecheck and ESLint on all 13 changed wellness source files passed. Removed an unused import found during lint.

validation.name: Web production export
validation.detail: npx.cmd expo export --platform web --output-dir dist-healthy-life-check completed.

validation.name: Browser interactions and layout
validation.detail: Headless Edge with synthetic auth and blocked external services: activity/habit creation, study-to-focus link, a full timer session and reflection, rest/skip, reload persistence, lighter-day application, learning-path persistence, quiet-hour save/reload. Eight sections checked at 320/390/768/1280 widths without horizontal page overflow; no page errors. Inspected phone screenshots and compacted the calendar after visual review.

validation.name: Educational sources
validation.detail: New nutrition myth, warm-up and seated-learning content checked against NHS primary pages; each lesson and learning path provides its own source link.

validation.name: Remaining limitations
validation.detail: No physical Android/iOS test or deployment. New workspace remains English. Existing local AsyncStorage/browser data is not separately encrypted; privacy states this. No biometric integration or automatic AI sharing. Browser reminders need an open permitted tab; focus break prompt is foreground-only. Custom activities do not automatically create OS reminders. Existing plans may overlap newly added plans and remain editable.
